sourceText.he: וְהַשַּׁמָּשׁ שֶׁאָכַל פָּחוֹת מִכְּזַיִת: פְּשִׁיטָא! אַיְּידִי דִּתְנָא רֵישָׁא ״כְּזַיִת״, תְּנָא סֵיפָא ״פָּחוֹת מִכְּזַיִת״.

positions.claim: a waiter who ate less than an olive-bulk is not included in a zimmun
the clause is obvious and was included only for parallelism with the first clause's olive-bulk
